gaps.criterion: A user can sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO
gaps.gap: Full flow verified only against a local OIDC mock (PKCE, RS256 ID token, state, nonce, linking, one-time exchange). Not yet run against real Google/Microsoft: no OAuth client credentials configured (SSO_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, SSO_MICROSOFT_*). Committed artifacts cover providers listing, disabled-provider 404, exchange negatives and the no-account UI message.
